Standard: For the MTEs in which the pilot's use of primary and standby flight displays and instruments is critical in performing the task, the characteristics of these displays and instruments do not lead to air vehicle flying qualities worse than Level 2. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis and simulation to assess the attributes of the primary and standby flight displays and instruments to include display latency and how the time delay is determined across all flight phases, loadings, configurations, and environmental conditions. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess the attributes of the primary and standby flight displays and instruments to include display latency and how the time delay is determined across all flight phases, loadings, configurations, and environmental conditions. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess the attributes of the primary and standby flight displays and instruments to include display latency and how the time delay is determined across all flight phases and environmental conditions.
